research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Moveworks is focused on enhancing the efficiency of enterprise systems by developing methods and systems for evaluating and improving the content of a knowledge datastore. This involves assessing the effectiveness of individual content snippets and prompting content creators to enhance those with low effectiveness. Additionally, Moveworks analyzes the supply and demand for content to optimize information accessibility and task automation across enterprise platforms.

overview_description.description: Moveworks offers an AI assistant that helps employees find information, automate tasks, and improve productivity across enterprise systems. product.name: The Moveworks Platform
product.description: An enterprise AI platform that helps employees search for information and complete tasks across business applications through conversational assistants and AI agents.

product.name: AI Assistant
product.description: A conversational enterprise assistant that answers employee questions, retrieves information, and completes tasks across connected business applications.

product.name: Agent Studio
product.description: A low-code and natural-language development environment for building, testing, and deploying AI agents and plugins that automate enterprise workflows.

product.name: Enterprise Search
product.description: A cross-application search capability that retrieves relevant enterprise content from systems such as Slack, SharePoint, Google Drive, OneDrive, Confluence, and Outlook.

product.name: Service Management
product.description: AI-enabled service management capabilities for handling employee requests, support interactions, and workflow execution across IT and other enterprise service functions.

product.name: Moveworks for ServiceNow Customers
product.description: An integration offering that combines Moveworks conversational AI and automation with ServiceNow workflows to provide a unified employee interface for search and action.
